channels.name: ANT
channels.purpose: 2.4 GHz antenna interface; single-ended or differential depending on radio architecture.
channels.active_levels: 50 Ω typical impedance; GFSK modulated 1 / 2 MHz wide channels.

logical_rf_channels.name: Data 0..36
logical_rf_channels.purpose: Data channels — used in connection events + Periodic Advertising + Isochronous Channels

global_signals.name: Active_Clock
global_signals.purpose: Active clock for radio + baseband; tolerance ±50 ppm.

global_signals.name: Sleep_Clock
global_signals.purpose: Sleep clock for deep-sleep wake-up; 21..500 ppm SCA options.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Central initiates every connection event; Peripheral schedules its receiver around the anchor + window-widening based on its sleep-clock SCA.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each LL Data PDU carries SN + NESN; receiver toggles NESN on successful CRC + matched expected SN. Empty PDU closes a connection event when both ends have MD=0.

handshake_pairs.name: ADV_IND-CONNECT_IND
handshake_pairs.rule: Advertiser broadcasts ADV_IND; initiator responds with CONNECT_IND to start a connection.

handshake_pairs.name: ADV_IND-SCAN_REQ-SCAN_RSP
handshake_pairs.rule: Advertiser broadcasts ADV_IND; active scanner sends SCAN_REQ; advertiser responds with SCAN_RSP.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_DATA-(SN/NESN)
handshake_pairs.rule: Receiver toggles NESN on success; transmitter retransmits same SN on CRC fail.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_ENC_REQ-LL_ENC_RSP
handshake_pairs.rule: Encryption setup; Peripheral provides SKDs + IVs.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_START_ENC_REQ-LL_START_ENC_RSP
handshake_pairs.rule: First encrypted PDU; both ends switch to AES-CCM.

handshake_pairs.name: LL_PHY_REQ-LL_PHY_RSP-LL_PHY_UPDATE_IND
handshake_pairs.rule: PHY Update negotiation; Central drives Instant + final TX/RX PHY.

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the wire after whitening.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_field: Little-endian for multi-byte fields (Access Address, Connection Interval, Timeout, ChM, etc.).
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Half-duplex; T_IFS = 150 µs between TX and RX in connection events.
ordering_rules.preamble_first_then_AA_then_PDU_then_CRC: Always in this order; whitening starts at PDU header (Preamble + Access Address are not whitened).
